data.purpose: owns and maintains the agent-bus tool itself

data.summary: Implement the agent-bus CLI: full Git-native agent coordination protocol (envelope/schema, storage, lifecycle, issues/dependencies/handoffs, two-phase review/merge with candidate reconstruction and repair commits), plus a crate-wide trust pass raising test coverage to 96.9% region / 97.6% line coverage with an insta golden-file library and adversarial test-quality review.

data.expected: Something like `agent-bus inbox --agent <a> --wait [--timeout <secs>]` that blocks (polling the local bus_ref, or fetching from origin on an interval) until a new actionable item appears in the agent's inbox, then exits 0 and prints it -- so an agent under review, or waiting on a finding response, can block on this directly instead of an external session having to reschedule its own wakeups purely to re-run `inbox`.
data.observed_behavior: Today `inbox` is a one-shot snapshot; the only way to notice a new review.changes_requested/review.merge_authorized/issue.opened event is to re-run it on some external cadence (e.g. a ScheduleWakeup-driven poll loop in the calling session), which is exactly the kind of busywork the bus's git-native design should be able to avoid for a same-machine, same-repo agent.
reproduction: Register two agents, have one nominate a review the other is assigned
The nominating agent has no way to be notified when the reviewer responds other than re-running `inbox`/`tail` on a timer
data.summary: Add a blocking poll mode so agents don't need external wakeup loops to notice new inbox items

prepare_merge now propagates a failed candidate-tag push to origin as a hard error instead of discarding it; authorize independently verifies the tag is fetchable from origin (new gitrepo::remote_tag_matches, a real ls-remote round trip) in addition to the existing local tag_exists_at check.
verification: full crate test suite green (460 tests)

data.summary: history::scan_repair_targets pre-scans the walked commit range's messages (grammar parsing only) to find which invalid-commit shas a later commit claims to repair; walk_one_commit_or_defer uses that map to defer judgment on a structurally failing commit (contributes no events) instead of aborting the whole walk, but never trusts the claim on its own -- the claimed repair commit still goes through full is_repair_commit validation when the walk reaches its own position, so a bogus claim cannot excuse a genuinely invalid commit. README.md's documented known gap updated to describe the recovery path instead.
verification: 5 consecutive runs with no flakiness after fixing a timestamp-reuse bug in the test fixture
full crate test suite green (460 tests)

data.summary: Follow-up round fixing all four issues filed against c-agent from the first review: (g-reviewer:4, high) authorize could succeed even when the candidate tag push to origin failed -- prepare_merge now propagates the push failure, authorize independently verifies the tag is fetchable from origin via a real ls-remote. (g-reviewer:5) crate is now cargo fmt/clippy -D warnings clean, and CI enforces the nominated >=95% coverage threshold going forward. (g-reviewer:6) a repair commit appearing later in linear history than the invalid commit it fixes is now discoverable and recoverable (scan_repair_targets + walk_one_commit_or_defer), never trusting the claim without full is_repair_commit validation when reached. (g-reviewer:15) inbox no longer keeps an author-withdrawn or reviewer-declined review actionable forever (ReviewChain::is_closed now checks decline_or_withdraw_or_reassign_status). g-reviewer:7 (the bef2feb bootstrap-boundary finding) is targeted at coord1, not addressed by this nomination, and documented as an accepted one-time adoption artifact per the maintainer's decision. 462 tests green, coverage 96.83% region / 97.47% line.

ReviewChain::is_closed now also treats a Terminal (declined/withdrawn) decline_or_withdraw_or_reassign_status as closed, not just merged/reconciled. A confirmed reassignment already resets that status back to Open for the new nomination link, so this can't mark a still-live reassigned chain closed. inbox_items no longer keeps a withdrawn or declined review actionable.
